displayName: Bluesky: post & schedule posts and threads (1Social)
description: Post to Bluesky and schedule Bluesky posts and threads from OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code or Codex. Publishes to the user's own Bluesky account via the 1Social MCP server (OAuth, no API key), checks the Bluesky 300-character limit and thread rules first, schedules up to 30 days ahead and returns a delivery receipt. Use to post or schedule on Bluesky, publish a post or a thread, plan Bluesky content, or check, edit or delete Bluesky posts.
